items.exampleEn: Please accept my sincere thanks for your help.
items.exampleZh: 對於你的幫忙，請接受我誠摯的謝意。

items.exampleEn: He calmly finished his breakfast while everyone else rushed.
items.exampleZh: 大家都匆匆忙忙的，他卻平靜地吃完早餐。

items.exampleEn: Shake the bottle vigorously before use.
items.exampleZh: 使用前請用力搖晃瓶子。

items.exampleEn: The song is about the loneliness of a long journey.
items.exampleZh: 這首歌唱的是長途旅程中的孤單。

items.exampleEn: He was an honorable man who kept every promise.
items.exampleZh: 他是個正直的人，每個承諾都會遵守。

items.exampleEn: He laughed nervously before the interview.
items.exampleZh: 面試前，他緊張地笑了笑。

items.exampleEn: She is in awe of her older sister's talent.
items.exampleZh: 她對姊姊的天分佩服得不得了。

items.exampleEn: Our dog has a gentle disposition.

items.sentenceEn: Admitting your mistake is always the honorable choice.
items.sentenceZh: 承認自己的錯誤，永遠是正直的選擇。

items.audioEn: I cleaned the pan vigorously, but the black marks didn't come off.
items.audioZh: 我用力刷了那個鍋子，但黑色的痕跡還是沒掉。

items.sentenceEn: His apology sounded sincere, so I forgave him.
items.sentenceZh: 他的道歉聽起來很真誠，所以我原諒他了。

items.sentenceEn: The puppy looked around nervously in its new home.
items.sentenceZh: 那隻小狗在新家裡緊張地東張西望。

items.stemEn: Even when the lights went out, the pilot spoke ____ to the passengers.
items.stemZh: 即使燈都熄了，機長還是冷靜地對乘客說話。

items.stemEn: The night guard slowly got used to the ____ of his job.
items.stemZh: 那位夜班警衛漸漸習慣了工作上的孤單。

items.passageEn: When my cousin moved to a big city for university, she felt a deep loneliness in her first month. She did not know anyone, spoke nervously in class, and became pessimistic about making friends. One weekend, she joined a hiking club. On the first trip, she stood in awe at the top of a mountain, looking at the clouds below. The club leader was very attentive and made everyone feel welcome. When one member got lost, the leader calmly called him and soon found him. My cousin now has many friends, and she says their kindness was sincere. Every Sunday, they hike vigorously for hours.
items.passageZh: 我的表親到大城市念大學時，第一個月覺得非常孤單。她誰也不認識，在課堂上說話很緊張，也對交朋友變得很悲觀。有個週末，她參加了一個登山社。第一次出遊時，她站在山頂上，驚嘆地看著底下的雲。社長很細心，讓每個人都覺得受歡迎。有一位社員走失時，他冷靜地打電話給對方，很快就找到人了。我的表親現在有很多朋友，她說大家的善意都是真心的。每個星期天，他們都會精力充沛地健行好幾個小時。

questions.questionZh: 作者的表親剛到大城市時怎麼樣？
options: 很快就適應了新的大學生活
每天都在忙著打工賺錢

questions.questionZh: 有人走失時，社長怎麼處理？
options: 冷靜地打電話，很快找到人

items.promptZh: 我弟弟天性開朗，很少生氣。
referenceEn: My brother has a cheerful disposition and rarely gets angry.
My little brother has a happy disposition and is rarely angry.
rubricZh: disposition 的用法，例如 a cheerful disposition、a happy disposition 等
時態合理（例如 has、gets 等）

items.promptZh: 比賽開始前，她緊張地在走廊上走來走去。
referenceEn: Before the race, she walked nervously up and down the hall.
She nervously walked back and forth in the hall before the race.
rubricZh: nervously 修飾動作，可放動詞前或後（例如 walked nervously、nervously walked 等）
「走來走去」可寫，例如 walk up and down、walk back and forth 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 walked、walks 等）
